summary: Tested v11 features: Interactive store map with Leaflet on Offerte page + enhanced DoveConviene scraping endpoint. All 5 backend tests pass (discover, nearby filtering OSM-only, manual scrape-offerte trigger with chains list, no-stores edge case, personalized offers using osm- prefixed supermarketIds). Frontend verified end-to-end with heavy_buyer@test.com: toggle Mappa/Lista button works, Leaflet map renders with 40 chain-colored store markers + 1 green user position marker, popups display store info, clicking Lista hides map, recommended section + product cards still functional. One minor UI gap: store section header does not display indirizzo when personalized mode is active (because the supMap built from personalized payload omits indirizzo).

integration_issues.flow: Store section header — show OSM address
integration_issues.issue: When personalized offers load, OffertePage builds supMap with only {id, nome, distanza_km} (lines 147-149) and does NOT copy 'indirizzo' from allStoresForMap. As a result the orange store-header section never shows the OSM address even though discover() returned it. Map popups DO show the address correctly because StoreMap reads from allStoresForMap directly.

passed_tests: POST /api/supermercati/discover?lat=45.4975&lng=9.3306&raggio_km=5 returns OSM stores with id starting 'osm-', lat/lng, catena
GET /api/supermercati/nearby returns ONLY fonte=osm stores when OSM stores exist in area, sorted by distance
POST /api/supermercati/scrape-offerte returns {message, stores>0, chains[]} for known area (Pioltello)
POST /api/supermercati/scrape-offerte returns 'Nessun negozio scoperto in zona' for area without OSM stores (Sahara test)
GET /api/offerte/personalizzate returns offers with supermarketId starting 'osm-' for OSM areas
Frontend: heavy_buyer@test.com login + navigation to /offerte loads location 'Pioltello — raggio 15 km'
Frontend: data-testid='toggle-map-btn' visible with text 'Mappa' when location set & stores discovered
Frontend: clicking Mappa shows data-testid='store-map' with 41 Leaflet markers (40 stores + 1 user pos)
Frontend: chain-colored markers render (E=Esselunga red, L=Lidl blue, A=Aldi navy, S=Sigma blue, M=MD red, etc.)
Frontend: green user-position marker centered on user coords
Frontend: toggle button text changes to 'Lista' when map is open; clicking Lista hides map (store-map detached)
Frontend: data-testid='recommended-section' (Consigliati per te) renders with personalized picks
Frontend: clicking offerta product card adds to quick list and shows add-to-list-toast
action_items: MINOR (optional): In /app/frontend/src/pages/OffertePage.js around line 147, when building supMap from personalized payload, also copy indirizzo from allStoresForMap[sid] so that orange store section headers show the address. e.g.: supMap[sid] = { id: sid, nome: o.supermarketName, distanza_km: o.distanceKm, indirizzo: allStoresForMap[sid]?.indirizzo }; (or merge allStoresForMap into supMap).
critical_code_review_comments: supermercati.py /discover correctly caches results for 7 days and falls back to cache, generates base catalog synchronously and offloads scraping to background — good separation.
/scrape-offerte endpoint correctly skips work when no OSM stores in radius (saves API quota for DoveConviene).
_background_scrape_offers iterates 40+ search terms with 1.5s sleep between requests — appropriate rate-limiting; logs warnings on per-term failures so one term failing won't crash entire job.

uuid import is at top of file — the 'if uuid in dir()' check inside _background_scrape_offers (line 201) is redundant/defensive but always evaluates True (uuid is imported globally). Minor but harmless.
StoreMap.js uses useMemo to filter stores with lat/lng; CHAIN_COLORS map covers 21 Italian chains with proper brand colors. Custom SVG icons inline keep bundle size small (no external icon assets).
OffertePage allStoresForMap is fetched via discover() which is cached on backend (7 days) — minimal load. Good.
data-testid='store-map' and 'toggle-map-btn' are present and stable for testing.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all critical flows pass; minor: address not shown in store header when personalized)

seed_data_creation: None — used existing OSM stores at Pioltello (40) discovered in previous iterations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend test file /app/backend/tests/test_map_and_scrape_v11.py covers map+scrape features. Note that discover endpoint is cached 7 days per cache_key (rounded lat/lng to 0.01). The personalized offers test takes ~90s on first call (full ranking). The only minor issue found is: when personalized mode is active, OffertePage.js does not propagate 'indirizzo' from allStoresForMap into supMap, so store-section headers omit the OSM address (the map popups show it correctly). Map renders 41 markers for Pioltello (40 OSM stores + 1 user pos green marker) — chain colors verified visually.
